A '''kilo-trem''' was a measurement of data storage capacity. The [[Jenet/Legends|Jenet]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Tols Vengra]] had ten thousand kilo-trems of storage capacity through the use of his [[Borg Construct Aj^6]].
